The '''Weequay blaster lance''' also known as an '''ancient blaster rifle''', '''long-barreled blaster rifle''', or simply '''Weequay Rifle''', was a type of exceptionally long-ranged [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] native to [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Weequay_blaster_lance_LoNH.png|thumb|left|250px|A Weequay blaster lance]]
An ancient model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]],<ref name="Ultimate Battles" /> the hard hitting blaster lance was developed by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] of [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] for desert warfare. Possessing unusually long barrels - some as long as two meters - blaster lances tended to be cumbersome. This was offset by their extreme range (even when compared to other rifles), which made it ideal for hunting in desert wastes where enemies could be spotted at great distances. Due to these qualities, blaster lances came to be revered for their ability to hit virtually anything visible under the light of [[Quay]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />

==History==
Blaster lances were used by several members of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. Some of Hondo's men attached blades to the ends of these rifles like [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonets]]. [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]], [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]], and [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)/Legends|another]] [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]], all members of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse, were known to use these type of rifles. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]] and [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]] were also seen carrying these weapons. The [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] used these blaster rifles as [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]]. The rifle was capable of delivering an electroshocks to droids, fire [[Stun/Legends|stun]] blast that disabled droids, and shooting blaster bolts.
